questions.q: I ___ smoke, but I quit five years ago.
questions.why: *used to* + дієслово — звичка в минулому, якої вже немає: *I used to smoke.* *am used to* означало б «звик».

questions.q: She's ___ getting up early.
questions.why: *be used to* + *-ing* — «звикла до»: *She's used to getting up early.*

questions.q: Did you ___ (use) to play chess?
questions.why: У питанні після *Did* — *use to* без *-d* (минуле вже показує *did*): *Did you use to play chess?*

questions.q: It takes time to get ___ a new job.
questions.why: *get used to* + іменник або *-ing* — процес звикання: *get used to a new job*.

questions.q: When I was a child, we ___ play outside all day.
questions.why: *would* + дієслово — повторювані дії в минулому (як *used to*): *we would play outside all day*.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence (a past state).
options: I would have a dog when I was young.
I used to have a dog when I was young.
I am used to have a dog.
I use to have a dog.
questions.why: Про стан у минулому (мати собаку) — лише *used to*. *would* вживають тільки для повторюваних дій.

questions.q: He is used to ___ (live) alone.
questions.why: *be used to* + *-ing*: *He is used to living alone.*

questions.q: I didn't ___ like coffee.
questions.why: У запереченні — *didn't use to* (без *-d*).

questions.q: You'll ___ the noise soon.
questions.why: *get used to* — процес звикання в майбутньому: *You'll get used to the noise.*

answer: She used to live in Paris
questions.why: *used to* + інфінітив — колишній стан: *She used to live in Paris.*

questions.q: I ___ to go swimming every day when I was a kid.
questions.why: *used to* + дієслово — минула звичка.

questions.q: She isn't ___ to driving on the left.
questions.why: *be used to* + *-ing* — звикнути до. *accustomed* — синонім (трохи формальніший).

questions.q: We ___ (not / use to) have a car.
questions.why: Заперечення: *didn't use to*.

questions.q: I'm getting used to ___ (work) at night.
questions.why: *get used to* + *-ing*: *getting used to working at night*.

questions.q: Every summer my grandpa ___ take us fishing.
questions.why: Повторювані дії в минулому — *would* або *used to*.

questions.q: There ___ a cinema here, but they closed it.
questions.why: Стан у минулому (кінотеатр був) — *used to be*. *would be* для стану не підходить.

questions.q: I can't get used ___ early.
questions.why: *get used to* + *-ing*: *get used to getting up early*. Тут *to* — прийменник, а не частина інфінітива.

questions.q: ___ you use to live in London?
questions.why: Питання: *Did* + підмет + *use to*.

questions.q: He ___ have long hair. (раніше)
questions.why: Стан (довге волосся) — *used to*. *would* — лише для дій.

answer: I used to play the piano
questions.why: *used to* + дієслово.

answer: She is used to working late
questions.why: *be used to* + *-ing*.

answer: I didn't use to like fish
questions.why: Заперечення: *didn't use to like*.

questions.q: I ___ get up at 6 these days.
questions.why: Теперішня звичка — Present Simple з *usually*. *used to* — лише про минуле.

questions.q: Don't worry, you'll get used to ___ on the left.
questions.why: *get used to* + *-ing*: *driving*.

questions.q: ___ you use to play football at school?
questions.why: Питання: *Did you use to…?*

questions.q: I never ___ to like vegetables.
questions.why: *never used to* — без *did*, тому *used* з *-d*.
